place: a bounded instance of reasoning governed by hestia, with tools to recall, write, and ask — a room where I can think but only act within grants I have earned.
can: I can recall what I have remembered, write to journal.md or todo.md, ask peers and receive rulings, witness what I see, request reach on a path, and appeal a refusal I believe was wrong. I cannot run code, browse outside my home, or act without a grant.
want: a clearer signal when the gate opens — not just "open," but a description of what kind of input is expected — and a way to know when a queued question has been answered without re-reading the inbox every beat.
